reason: A Web GUI environment housekeeping plugin for toolchain inventory, constrained cache cleanup, and editing global agent rules files.

summaries.zh: 在 Web GUI 设置中清点工具链、清理受白名单保护的缓存目录，并编辑全局 AGENTS.md 规则文件。
summaries.en: A Web GUI settings plugin for inventorying toolchains, cleaning whitelisted cache paths, and editing the global AGENTS.md rules file.

capabilities: Inventories installed toolchains and executable locations
Scans configured project temporary and cache directories
Deletes whitelisted cache paths with path and realpath checks
Reads and writes the fixed DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md rules file
Creates backups of the previous rules file and supports restore
